consents.title: Telehealth Informed Consent
consents.body:
DRAFT — pending Dr. Om and counsel review. UNZIT provides store-and-forward telehealth by Dr. Om. Online care has limits and risks and may require an in-person referral. Not for emergencies; call 911 in an emergency. Review within 1 to 2 business days.

I acknowledge that I must be physically in North Carolina for care, verify my identity with a government photo ID and live selfie, and provide complete intake answers and adequate photos. Care lets me use any US pharmacy and pay it directly. All-In includes partner-pharmacy prescriptions through Vida. Prescriptions are provided only when appropriate. Prescriptions are sent outside this app through TreatRx; the app records that they were sent.

If I notice any side effect, even a small one, I will stop that medication and message UNZIT. I will not restart it until Dr. Om replies. I am responsible for obtaining recommended in-person care. I may withdraw consent to telehealth. I consent to care records and sharing for my care; marketing use requires separate permission. UNZIT does not bill insurance.

I ACCEPT.

consents.title: Medication Consent
consents.body:
DRAFT — pending Dr. Om and counsel review. Treatment may include tretinoin, hydroquinone, doxycycline, spironolactone, benzoyl peroxide, clindamycin, azelaic acid, tazarotene or dapsone. These medicines have benefits, risks and pregnancy warnings. Compounded medicines are not FDA approved. Spironolactone for acne and doxycycline 40 mg modified release for acne are off-label uses. Alternatives include in-person care.

Tell Dr. Om about pregnancy, breastfeeding, plans for pregnancy, allergies, medical conditions and all medicines and supplements. Pregnant, breastfeeding, trying, or not sure: no tretinoin, tazarotene, hydroquinone, doxycycline or spironolactone.

If I notice any side effect, even a small one, I will stop that medication and message UNZIT. I will not restart it until Dr. Om replies. Facial or throat swelling, hives, trouble breathing, severe headache with vision change, fainting, irregular heartbeat or a blistering rash: stop medication and call 911 or go to an emergency department now.

I ACCEPT.

consents.title: Privacy Notice
consents.body:
DRAFT — pending Dr. Om and counsel review. UNZIT is operated by The Derm Guy LLC dba UNZIT. This draft describes protection under HIPAA and North Carolina law; applicable legal status remains subject to counsel review.

We collect identity, health, payment information through Stripe, and device and usage information. Care information may be shared with pharmacies, other treating clinicians and service providers covered by business associate agreements. There are no advertising pixels in the logged-in app or intake. Photos are private and location metadata is removed from uploaded images.

You may request access to your records (usually within 30 days), amendment, an accounting of disclosures for six years, restrictions and confidential communications. You may complain to HHS Office for Civil Rights. Proposed record retention is 11 years after your last visit, pending counsel confirmation. The privacy mailing address and effective date remain pending review.

Website and waitlist email, state and answers are kept for launch notices. Do not send health information through the website form.

I ACKNOWLEDGE.

consents.title: Subscription and Refund Terms
consents.body:
DRAFT — pending Dr. Om and counsel review. Your selected UNZIT membership renews automatically each month until cancelled. Your monthly price is the price shown for your selected plan at Checkout, supplied by UNZIT’s current server settings. Payment uses Stripe Checkout. The billing period starts at payment. Manage cancellation and plan changes in the Stripe Customer Portal. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the paid period. Plan changes are prorated immediately through Stripe; a credit is not a promise of a cash refund. Price changes are notified by email.

Care includes dermatologist review, a treatment plan, messaging and monthly photo check-ins from clinical approval; prescriptions at your chosen US pharmacy are paid directly by you. All-In includes partner prescriptions filled by Vida and shipped to your North Carolina address, with weekly check-ins for the first eight weeks from approval, then monthly. Prescriptions only if appropriate. OTC products, in-person care and labs are not included.

You are not charged if found ineligible before payment. If your case is rejected at clinical review, the latest paid invoice is refunded in full and the subscription is cancelled immediately. No refund after a plan is issued. Medicines already shipped cannot be returned. Review within 1 to 2 business days.

I AGREE.

steps.title: Best for
steps.instructions: mostly blackheads and whiteheads.

steps.title: Morning
steps.instructions: gentle cleanser; moisturizer; SPF 30+.

steps.title: Evening
steps.instructions: Tretinoin 0.025% (0.018% if very sensitive or deeper skin tone), pea-sized, every other night for 2 weeks, then nightly; moisturizer.

steps.title: Prescription directions
steps.instructions: tretinoin 0.025% (or 0.018%), sig "pea-sized, every other night x 2 weeks, then nightly."

steps.title: Treatment rules
steps.instructions: Clindamycin never without BPO. Doxycycline never alone: use with BPO and a topical retinoid, which continue after doxycycline stops. Do not start tretinoin and hydroquinone in the same week; add the other after 2 weeks. Use one retinoid at a time; remove OTC retinol and adapalene.

steps.title: Side effects and contact
steps.instructions: If you notice any side effect, even a small one, stop that medication and message us. Do not restart it until Dr. Om replies. Review within 1 to 2 business days. Not for emergencies. If you have trouble breathing, swelling of your face or throat, chest pain, or another emergency, call 911.
